verdicts.reason: Both pull the quote out of the floral frame, which now shows the stock 'BEAUTY ILLUSTRATION / HAND DRAWN ELEMENTS' placeholder text, so the original's quote-inside-frame concept is broken and the frame looks like an unrelated thumbnail. A wraps the attribution to 'CAROLYN / MURPHY', jammed right under 'MAKEUP.', and leaves 'MEN' alone on the first line. B leaves 'JUST' orphaned on its own line, and its one-line 'CAROLYN MURPHY' runs almost edge to edge with no margin, so A is marginally cleaner.
